prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: The Hackathon Win
irony: The bots try to hide each bug to look like winners, but singing each bug out loud becomes the song that wins.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon runs ten days online, Oct 26 to Nov 4, opening with a kickoff livestream (dev.meta.ai).
Builders enter the Indie developer track, judged on creativity, technical ambition, and whether it works (dev.meta.ai).
Meta and partners run live workshops while teams build, and projects are due Nov 4 (dev.meta.ai).
Judging runs Nov 4 to 8 and winners are named at the closing ceremony with live finals on Nov 9 (fact sheet).
Musical Bots turns a one-line idea plus Premiere into a sung 3D browser musical with live synthesized voices (docs/SUBMISSION.md).
The crew of eight bots builds heads, floating hands, and three sets: the diner, the big house, and the street (git log).
A twenty-thousand-word dictionary fixed mush singing like box and hack-KA-thun (git log).
A lyric gate stamped no until lines rhymed and fit the beat, and Green rewrote them ringing (git log).
The team coded with Muse Code past midnight on three nights, fixing White sung as Why at 1:57 am (git log).
Black joined the crew on Nov 1 as the plot trouble who dreams up the problems (git log).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Night on the street; the laptop glows on the porch while Green reads the hackathon kickoff to the gathered bots.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green pitches entering the Indie track with Musical Bots: type one line, press Premiere, sixteen bots sing; he keeps rechecking the rules, scared to start.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: News of the Nov 4 deadline and the three judging tests lands; the first sung words come out as mush, and Black dares the song to flop.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: On the diner stage the cast rehearses the dream: win the hackathon, hear their name called at the closing show.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The first try flops: the lyric gate stamps no, the high-five whiffs, the camera stares at clouds while the spotlight burns the walls white.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Past midnight the team codes with Muse by the glowing laptop, yawning through double songs, bumping heads, and White sung as Why.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: On the diner stage the cast sings the dream again, louder: win the hackathon, hear their name called.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold stops the bumping bots: from now on everyone looks ahead and steps right, so nobody bumps heads anymore.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides to ship what works, fix one bug at a time, and finish before the deadline; Green agrees to sing the fixed lines.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold turns the chant: the bugs they sang became the song, and the winning name is Musical Bots at the Meta show.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: At the closing show the judges press Premiere, the bots sing, and the called name is Musical Bots; the street cheers its own song.
